Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.protocol

Record Class QueryEntities.EntityData

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.protocol.QueryEntities.EntityData
Record Components:
uuid - The entity's UUID.
typeKey - Namespaced entity type key.
x - Position X.
y - Position Y.
z - Position Z.
customName - The entity's custom name, or null when unnamed.
pdcKeys - Namespaced keys present in the entity's persistent data container.
transform - The display transformation for display entities, or null for all other entities.
Enclosing class:
QueryEntities
public static record QueryEntities.EntityData(UUID uuid, String typeKey, double x, double y, double z, @Nullable String customName, List<String> pdcKeys, @Nullable QueryEntities.TransformData transform) extends Record
A single entity's state, read in the same main-thread burst as its siblings.

    • equals

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with '=='.
